answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 860 aliases means 860 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. What carries the river here is verification, the canyon of cost is what stops the farm, and the tundra of the record keeps every claim checkable.
